content: A fast-paced 15-second cinematic sci-fi sports sequence. A young female cyborg with short black hair and a robotic arm backflips off a towering crane into a high-speed freefall toward a futuristic stadium below. The camera rapidly tracks her vertical descent into a perfect superhero landing on the soccer pitch, kicking up dust. She instantly breaks into a sprint, flawlessly dribbles past defenders, and fires a powerful shot into the top corner of the goal net. The stadium erupts with cheering crowds and raining confetti. Hyper-realistic, dynamic camera pans, high-velocity motion blur, 8K CGI
